selection: inner pair OOF averaged per physical trial; maximize trial AUC then fixed05 F1 then candidate order; select CSP first, then fusion weight
baseline_scope: frozen subject-held-out model; original unlabeled whole-subject zscore is retained, transductive not label leakage
raw_reverse_controls: same inner-selected CSP candidate with forced raw/reverse, diagnostic only
extension: at least 3 baseline AUC improvements and regression protection; no automatic expansion
